---- MODULE Zab ----
EXTENDS ZabDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL ZBFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA ZBLibraryFinite ==
  \A S : /\ ZBFinite!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
         /\ ZBFinite!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
BY Isa DEF ZBFinite!IsFiniteSet, ZBFinite!Cardinality,
                    IsFiniteSet, Cardinality

ZBSids(C) == {c.sid : c \in C}
ZBCRecords == [sid : Server, connected : BOOLEAN, epoch : Nat]
ZBCWell(C) == /\ C \subseteq ZBCRecords
              /\ IsFiniteSet(C)
              /\ \A c, d \in C : c.sid = d.sid => c = d
ZBLow(C, e) == {c.sid : c \in {d \in C : d.epoch < e}}

LEMMA ZBQuorumFacts ==
  /\ ZBQuorumIntersection::(
      \A Q : \A R : (
        /\ (IsQuorum(Q))
        /\ (IsQuorum(R))
      ) => (
        Q \cap R # {}
      )
     )
  /\ ZBQuorumMonotone::(
      \A Q : \A R : (
        /\ (IsQuorum(Q))
        /\ (Q \subseteq R)
        /\ (R \subseteq Server)
      ) => (
        IsQuorum(R)
      )
     )
  /\ ZBQuorumSingleton::(
      \A s \in Server : (
        /\ (IsQuorum({s}))
      ) => (
        Server = {s}
      )
     )
<1>1. ASSUME NEW Q, NEW R, IsQuorum(Q), IsQuorum(R)
      PROVE Q \cap R # {}
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. /\ Q \subseteq Server /\ R \subseteq Server
        /\ IsFiniteSet(Q) /\ IsFiniteSet(R)
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Subset, SMTT("r2") DEF IsQuorum, Quorums
  <2>2. Cardinality(Q) + Cardinality(R) > Cardinality(Server)
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_CardinalityType, SMTT("r2")
       DEF IsQuorum, Quorums
  <2>3. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, <2>2, ServerFinite,
                ZBFinite!FS_MajoritiesIntersect, SMTT("r2")
<1>2. ASSUME NEW Q, NEW R, IsQuorum(Q), Q \subseteq R, R \subseteq Server
      PROVE IsQuorum(R)
  <2> USE <1>2
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(R) BY ZBLibraryFinite, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Subset, SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. /\ Cardinality(Q) <= Cardinality(R)
        /\ Cardinality(Q) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(R) \in Nat
        /\ Cardinality(Server) \in Nat
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Subset,
       ZBFinite!FS_CardinalityType, SMTT("r2") DEF IsQuorum, Quorums
  <2>3. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>2, SMTT("r2") DEF IsQuorum, Quorums
<1>3. ASSUME NEW s \in Server, IsQuorum({s})
      PROVE Server = {s}
  <2> USE <1>3
  <2>1. /\ Cardinality(Server) \in Nat
        /\ Cardinality({s}) = 1
        /\ Cardinality(Server) < 2
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_CardinalityType, ZBFinite!FS_Singleton,
       SMTT("r2") DEF IsQuorum, Quorums
  <2>2. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, ServerFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Subset,
                ZBFinite!FS_Singleton, SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r2")

ZBHasNatMaximum(T) == T = {} \/ (\E m \in T : \A x \in T : x <= m)

LEMMA ZBMaximumExists ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S \subseteq Nat
  PROVE ZBHasNatMaximum(S)
<1>1. ZBHasNatMaximum({}) BY SMTT("r1") DEF ZBHasNatMaximum
<1>2. ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, ZBFinite!IsFiniteSet(T),
             ZBHasNatMaximum(T), NEW x \in S \ T
      PROVE ZBHasNatMaximum(T \cup {x})
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r3") DEF ZBHasNatMaximum
<1>3. ZBFinite!IsFiniteSet(S) BY ZBLibraryFinite, SMTT("r1")
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, ZBFinite!FS_Induction, IsaM("iprover")

LEMMA ZBRecordFacts ==
  /\ ZBMaximumNat::(
      \A S : (
        /\ (S \subseteq Nat)
        /\ (S # {})
        /\ (IsFiniteSet(S))
      ) => (
        /\ Maximum(S) \in S
        /\ \A n \in S : n < Maximum(S) + 1
      )
     )
  /\ ZBCUpdate::(
      \A C : \A s \in Server : \A e \in Nat : (
        /\ (ZBCWell(C))
      ) => (
        /\ ZBCWell(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e))
        /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
        /\ \A b \in Nat :
             ZBLow(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e), b) =
               (ZBLow(C, b) \ {s}) \cup (IF e < b THEN {s} ELSE {})
        /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)
      )
     )
  /\ ZBCRemove::(
      \A C : \A s \in Server : (
        /\ (ZBCWell(C))
      ) => (
        /\ ZBCWell(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s))
        /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
        /\ \A b \in Nat : ZBLow(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s), b) = ZBLow(C, b)
        /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)
      )
     )
  /\ ZBCMaximum::(
      \A C : (
        /\ (ZBCWell(C))
        /\ (C # {})
      ) => (
        /\ Maximum({c.epoch : c \in C}) \in Nat
        /\ \A c \in C : c.epoch < Maximum({d.epoch : d \in C}) + 1
      )
     )
  /\ ZBCepochSids::(
      \A C : \A s : \A e : (
        /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C,s,e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
        /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C,s)) = ZBSids(C)
      )
     )
  /\ ZBAckSids::(
      \A C : \A s : \A e : \A h : (
        /\ ZBSids(UpdateAckeRecv(C, s, e, h)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
        /\ ZBSids(RemoveAckeRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
      )
     )
<1>1. ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Nat, S # {}, IsFiniteSet(S)
      PROVE /\ Maximum(S) \in S
            /\ \A n \in S : n < Maximum(S) + 1
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. QED BY ZBMaximumExists, SMTT("r3") DEF Maximum, ZBHasNatMaximum
<1>2. ASSUME NEW C, ZBCWell(C), NEW s \in Server, NEW e \in Nat
      PROVE /\ ZBCWell(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e))
            /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
            /\ \A b \in Nat :
                 ZBLow(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e), b) =
                   (ZBLow(C, b) \ {s}) \cup (IF e < b THEN {s} ELSE {})
            /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)
  <2> USE <1>2
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e))
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Difference, ZBFinite!FS_AddElement, SMTT("r5")
       DEF UpdateCepochRecv, ZBCWell
  <2>2. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, SMTT("r10")
              DEF UpdateCepochRecv, ZBCWell, ZBCRecords, ZBSids, ZBLow
<1>3. ASSUME NEW C, ZBCWell(C), NEW s \in Server
      PROVE /\ ZBCWell(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s))
            /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
            /\ \A b \in Nat : ZBLow(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s), b) = ZBLow(C, b)
            /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)
  <2> USE <1>3
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s))
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Difference, ZBFinite!FS_AddElement, SMTT("r5")
       DEF RemoveCepochRecv, ZBCWell
  <2>2. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, SMTT("r10")
              DEF RemoveCepochRecv, ZBCWell, ZBCRecords, ZBSids, ZBLow
<1>4. ASSUME NEW C, ZBCWell(C), C # {}
      PROVE /\ Maximum({c.epoch : c \in C}) \in Nat
            /\ \A c \in C : c.epoch < Maximum({d.epoch : d \in C}) + 1
  <2> USE <1>4
  <2>1. /\ IsFiniteSet({c.epoch : c \in C})
        /\ {c.epoch : c \in C} \subseteq Nat
        /\ {c.epoch : c \in C} # {}
    BY ZBLibraryFinite, ZBFinite!FS_Image, Isa DEF ZBCWell, ZBCRecords
  <2>2. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, <2>1, <1>1, SMTT("r3")
<1>5. ASSUME NEW C, NEW s, NEW e
      PROVE /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C,s,e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
            /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C,s)) = ZBSids(C)
  <2> USE <1>5
  <2>1. QED BY SMTT("r3") DEF ZBSids, UpdateCepochRecv, RemoveCepochRecv
<1>6. ASSUME NEW C, NEW s, NEW e, NEW h
      PROVE /\ ZBSids(UpdateAckeRecv(C, s, e, h)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
            /\ ZBSids(RemoveAckeRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
  <2> USE <1>6
  <2>1. QED BY ZBLibraryFinite, SMTT("r5") DEF ZBSids, UpdateAckeRecv, RemoveAckeRecv
<1>7. QED
  <2>1. \A S : (
          /\ (S \subseteq Nat)
          /\ (S # {})
          /\ (IsFiniteSet(S))
        ) => (
          /\ Maximum(S) \in S
          /\ \A n \in S : n < Maximum(S) + 1
        )
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. \A C : \A s \in Server : \A e \in Nat : (
          /\ (ZBCWell(C))
        ) => (
          /\ ZBCWell(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e))
          /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
          /\ \A b \in Nat :
               ZBLow(UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e), b) =
                 (ZBLow(C, b) \ {s}) \cup (IF e < b THEN {s} ELSE {})
          /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in UpdateCepochRecv(C, s, e)
        )
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r5")
  <2>3. \A C : \A s \in Server : (
          /\ (ZBCWell(C))
        ) => (
          /\ ZBCWell(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s))
          /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
          /\ \A b \in Nat : ZBLow(RemoveCepochRecv(C, s), b) = ZBLow(C, b)
          /\ \A c \in C : c.sid # s => c \in RemoveCepochRecv(C, s)
        )
    BY <1>3, SMTT("r5")
  <2>4. \A C : (
          /\ (ZBCWell(C))
          /\ (C # {})
        ) => (
          /\ Maximum({c.epoch : c \in C}) \in Nat
          /\ \A c \in C : c.epoch < Maximum({d.epoch : d \in C}) + 1
        )
    BY <1>4, SMTT("r5")
  <2>5. \A C : \A s : \A e : (
          /\ ZBSids(UpdateCepochRecv(C,s,e)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
          /\ ZBSids(RemoveCepochRecv(C,s)) = ZBSids(C)
        )
    BY <1>5, SMTT("r5")
  <2>6. \A C : \A s : \A e : \A h : (
          /\ ZBSids(UpdateAckeRecv(C, s, e, h)) = ZBSids(C) \cup {s}
          /\ ZBSids(RemoveAckeRecv(C, s)) = ZBSids(C)
        )
    BY <1>6, SMTT("r5")
  <2>7. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, SMTT("r2")

ZBSeq(h) == \E S : h \in Seq(S)

LEMMA ZBSeqWiden ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, NEW h, h \in Seq(S), S \subseteq T
  PROVE h \in Seq(T)
BY SMTT("r3")

LEMMA ZBSequenceFacts ==
  /\ ZBSeqFacts::(
      \A h : (
        /\ (ZBSeq(h))
      ) => (
        /\ Len(h) \in Nat
        /\ DOMAIN h = 1..Len(h)
        /\ h = [k \in 1..Len(h) |-> h[k]]
        /\ (h # <<>> => Len(h) > 0)
      )
     )
  /\ ZBEmptySeq::(
      ZBSeq(<<>>) /\ Len(<<>>) = 0
     )
  /\ ZBAppendSeq::(
      \A h : \A m : (
        /\ (ZBSeq(h))
      ) => (
        /\ ZBSeq(Append(h, m))
        /\ Len(Append(h, m)) = Len(h) + 1
        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Append(h, m)) :
             Append(h, m)[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE m
      )
     )
  /\ ZBTailSeq::(
      \A h : (
        /\ (ZBSeq(h))
        /\ (h # <<>>)
      ) => (
        /\ ZBSeq(Tail(h))
        /\ Len(Tail(h)) = Len(h) - 1
        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Tail(h)) : Tail(h)[k] = h[k+1]
      )
     )
<1>1. ASSUME NEW h, ZBSeq(h)
      PROVE /\ Len(h) \in Nat
            /\ DOMAIN h = 1..Len(h)
            /\ h = [k \in 1..Len(h) |-> h[k]]
            /\ (h # <<>> => Len(h) > 0)
  <2> USE <1>1
  <2>1. QED BY SMTT("r3") DEF ZBSeq
<1>2. ZBSeq(<<>>) /\ Len(<<>>) = 0
  <2>1. <<>> \in Seq({}) BY SMTT("r1")
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1, SMTT("r1") DEF ZBSeq
<1>3. ASSUME NEW h, ZBSeq(h), NEW m
      PROVE /\ ZBSeq(Append(h, m))
            /\ Len(Append(h, m)) = Len(h) + 1
            /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Append(h, m)) :
                 Append(h, m)[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE m
  <2> USE <1>3
  <2>1. PICK S : h \in Seq(S) BY SMTT("r1") DEF ZBSeq
  <2>2. h \in Seq(S \cup {m}) BY <2>1, ZBSeqWiden, SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. Append(h,m) \in Seq(S \cup {m}) BY <2>2, SMTT("r3")
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>3, SMTT("r3") DEF ZBSeq
<1>4. ASSUME NEW h, ZBSeq(h), h # <<>>
      PROVE /\ ZBSeq(Tail(h))
            /\ Len(Tail(h)) = Len(h) - 1
            /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Tail(h)) : Tail(h)[k] = h[k+1]
  <2> USE <1>4
  <2>1. PICK S : h \in Seq(S) BY SMTT("r1") DEF ZBSeq
  <2>2. Tail(h) \in Seq(S) BY <2>1, SMTT("r3")
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r3") DEF ZBSeq
<1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, SMTT("r2")

\* A message buffer is attached to a live leader--follower connection.
ZBLink(s, t) ==
  \/ /\ IsLeader(s) /\ IsFollower(t) /\ connectInfo[t] = s
  \/ /\ IsLeader(t) /\ IsFollower(s) /\ connectInfo[s] = t

ZBNetwork ==
  /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ learners \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ connectInfo \in [Server -> Server \cup {NullPoint}]
  /\ leaderOracle \in Server \cup {NullPoint}
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       /\ (~IsFollower(s) => connectInfo[s] = NullPoint)
       /\ (~IsLeader(s) => learners[s] = {})
       /\ (IsLeader(s) => s \in learners[s])
  /\ \A s, t \in Server :
       (t \in learners[s] /\ t # s)
       <=> (IsFollower(t) /\ connectInfo[t] = s)

LEMMA ZBStartNetworkFacts ==
  /\ ZBNetworkInitially::(
      Init => ZBNetwork
     )
  /\ ZBStartLeaderNetwork::(
      \A s \in Server : (
        /\ (ZBNetwork)
        /\ (IsLooking(s))
        /\ (state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = LEADING])
        /\ (learners' = [learners EXCEPT ![s] = {s}])
        /\ (UNCHANGED connectInfo)
        /\ (leaderOracle' \in Server \cup {NullPoint})
      ) => (
        ZBNetwork'
      )
     )
  /\ ZBStartFollowerNetwork::(
      \A s \in Server : (
        /\ (ZBNetwork)
        /\ (IsLooking(s))
        /\ (state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = FOLLOWING])
        /\ (UNCHANGED <<learners, connectInfo, leaderOracle>>)
      ) => (
        ZBNetwork'
      )
     )
<1>1. Init => ZBNetwork

  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
     DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitLeaderVars, InitFollowerVars,
         InitElectionVars, InitMsgVars, ZBNetwork, ZBLink,
         IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING
<1>2. ASSUME NEW s \in Server,
             ZBNetwork, IsLooking(s),
             state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = LEADING],
             learners' = [learners EXCEPT ![s] = {s}],
             UNCHANGED connectInfo,
             leaderOracle' \in Server \cup {NullPoint}
      PROVE ZBNetwork'
  <2> USE <1>2
  <2>1. /\ state' \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
        /\ learners' \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
        /\ connectInfo' \in [Server -> Server \cup {NullPoint}]
        /\ leaderOracle' \in Server \cup {NullPoint}
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF ZBNetwork
  <2>2. \A t \in Server :
         /\ (~IsFollower(t) => connectInfo[t] = NullPoint)'
         /\ (~IsLeader(t) => learners[t] = {})'
         /\ (IsLeader(t) => t \in learners[t])'
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF ZBNetwork, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsLooking,
       LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING
  <2>3. \A t, u \in Server :
         ((u \in learners[t] /\ u # t)
           <=> (IsFollower(u) /\ connectInfo[u] = t))'
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF ZBNetwork, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsLooking,
       LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF ZBNetwork
<1>3. ASSUME NEW s \in Server,
             ZBNetwork, IsLooking(s),
             state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = FOLLOWING],
             UNCHANGED <<learners, connectInfo, leaderOracle>>
      PROVE ZBNetwork'
  <2> USE <1>3
  <2>1. /\ state' \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
        /\ learners' \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
        /\ connectInfo' \in [Server -> Server \cup {NullPoint}]
        /\ leaderOracle' \in Server \cup {NullPoint}
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF ZBNetwork
  <2>2. \A t \in Server :
         /\ (~IsFollower(t) => connectInfo[t] = NullPoint)'
         /\ (~IsLeader(t) => learners[t] = {})'
         /\ (IsLeader(t) => t \in learners[t])'
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF ZBNetwork, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsLooking,
       LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING
  <2>3. \A t, u \in Server :
         ((u \in learners[t] /\ u # t)
           <=> (IsFollower(u) /\ connectInfo[u] = t))'
    BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
       DEF ZBNetwork, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsLooking,
           LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1") DEF ZBNetwork
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r2")

LEMMA ZBNetworkStep == ZBNetwork /\ [Next]_vars => ZBNetwork'
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME ZBNetwork, [Next]_vars
              PROVE ZBNetwork'
  BY SMTT("r1")
<1> USE <1>1
<1>2. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r1")
     DEF vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars,
         msgVars, verifyVars, ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower
<1>3. CASE \E i \in Server : UpdateLeader(i)
  BY <1>3, ZBStartNetworkFacts, SMTT("r5")
     DEF UpdateLeader, IsLooking, SwitchToLeader,
         serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>4. CASE \E i \in Server : FollowLeader(i)
  BY <1>4, ZBStartNetworkFacts, SMTT("r5")
     DEF FollowLeader, IsLooking, SwitchToLeader, SwitchToFollower,
         serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>5. CASE \E i, j \in Server : Timeout(i, j)
  BY <1>5, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF Timeout, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader, RemoveLearner, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>6. CASE \E i \in Server : Restart(i)
  BY <1>6, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF Restart, IsLooking, HasLeader, RemoveLearner, FollowerShutdown, LeaderShutdown, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>7. CASE \E i, j \in Server : ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i, j)
  BY <1>7, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, IsMyLearner, HasNoLeader, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>8. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i, j)
  BY <1>8, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF LeaderProcessCEPOCH, IsMyLearner, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>9. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH(i, j)
  BY <1>9, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, IsMyLeader, FollowerShutdown, RemoveLearner, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>10. CASE \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
  BY <1>10, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF LeaderProcessACKEPOCH, IsMyLearner, 
         ZBNetwork, ZBLink, IsLeader, IsFollower,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars, leaderVars,
         followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>11. CASE \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)
  BY <1>11, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, IsMyLeader, FollowerShutdown, RemoveLearner,

  /\ currentEpoch[s] = acceptedEpoch[s]

ZBEpochState ==
  /\ currentEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ zabState \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ \A s \in Server : currentEpoch[s] <= acceptedEpoch[s]
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       IsLeader(s) /\ zabState[s] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
        => ZBPhaseLeader(s)

ZBAckState ==
  /\ ackeRecv = [s \in Server |-> ackeRecv[s]]
  /\ \A s \in Server : ZBSids(ackeRecv[s]) \subseteq Server
  /\ \A s \in Server : IsLeader(s) =>
       /\ (\A t \in ZBSids(ackeRecv[s]) : acceptedEpoch[t] >= acceptedEpoch[s])
       /\ (~CepochRecvQuorumFormed(s) => ZBSids(ackeRecv[s]) = {s})
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       /\ IsLeader(s)
       /\ AckeRecvQuorumFormed(s)
       /\ ZBSids(ackeRecv[s]) \ {s} # {}
       => zabState[s] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}

ZBPreQuorum ==
  \A s \in Server : IsLeader(s) /\ ~CepochRecvQuorumFormed(s)
    => \/ ZBSids(cepochRecv[s]) \subseteq learners[s]
       \/ IsQuorum(learners[s])

ZBProtocolMsg(s, t, m) ==
  /\ (m.mtype \in {CEPOCH, NEWEPOCH} => m.mepoch \in Nat)
  /\ (m.mtype = CEPOCH =>
       /\ IsFollower(s) /\ IsLeader(t)
       /\ m.mepoch <= acceptedEpoch[s]
       /\ (~CepochRecvQuorumFormed(t) => m.mepoch = acceptedEpoch[s]))
  /\ (m.mtype = NEWEPOCH =>
       /\ IsLeader(s) /\ CepochRecvQuorumFormed(s)
       /\ m.mepoch = acceptedEpoch[s])
  /\ (m.mtype = ACKEPOCH =>
       /\ IsLeader(t) /\ CepochRecvQuorumFormed(t)
       /\ acceptedEpoch[s] >= acceptedEpoch[t])
  /\ (m.mtype = NEWLEADER =>
       /\ ZBPhaseLeader(s) /\ m.mepoch = acceptedEpoch[s]
       /\ m.mepoch <= acceptedEpoch[t])
  /\ (m.mtype = ACKLD => ZBPhaseLeader(t))

ZBProtocolMsgs ==
  \A s, t \in Server : \A k \in 1..Len(msgs[s][t]) :
    ZBProtocolMsg(s, t, msgs[s][t][k])

ZBElectionAux ==
  /\ ZBWireInv /\ ZBCore /\ ZBEpochState /\ ZBAckState
  /\ ZBPreQuorum /\ ZBProtocolMsgs

ZBAcceptedMonotone ==
  \A s \in Server : acceptedEpoch[s] <= acceptedEpoch'[s]

ZBChosenStable ==
  \A s \in Server :
    /\ IsLeader(s) /\ IsLeader(s)' /\ CepochRecvQuorumFormed(s)
    => /\ CepochRecvQuorumFormed(s)'
       /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] = acceptedEpoch[s]
